{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Only completed orders
completed_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'completed'
df_completed = df_clean[completed_mask].copy()

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate within each segment
conv_by_channel_segment = df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Access email and paid_search rates by .loc
email_rates = conv_by_channel_segment.loc['email']
paid_search_rates = conv_by_channel_segment.loc['paid_search']

# Compute difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) within each segment
diff_conv = email_rates - paid_search_rates

# Print the difference for each segment as individual values
print("Difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(f"loyal: {diff_conv['loyal']:.6f}")
print(f"new: {diff_conv['new']:.6f}")
print(f"returning: {diff_conv['returning']:.6f}")

# Also compute average revenue by channel within each segment
rev_by_channel_segment = df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
email_revs = rev_by_channel_segment.loc['email']
paid_search_revs = rev_by_channel_segment.loc['paid_search']

# Difference in revenue
diff_rev = email_revs - paid_search_revs

# Print the difference for each segment as individual values
print("\nDifference in average revenue (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(f"loyal: {diff_rev['loyal']:.6f}")
print(f"new: {diff_rev['new']:.6f}")
print(f"returning: {diff_rev['returning']:.6f}")"}
